title: Giga Couch web-1 package
description: Minimal local package for the web-1 browser. This schema does not describe hashes, signatures, or a certified sandbox.

max.description: Optional. The most players this game allows. Players past it wait on their phones or pads until there is room.

players.description: How many people can play. Without max, everyone who joins gets to play; phones make dozens possible.

phone.description: Phone controllers while this game is open: the layout, and the game's own sounds. Without it, phones show stick-2 and only the stock sounds play.

layout.description: stick-2: stick, A, B. dpad-2: d-pad, A, B, Start. stick-4: stick, A, B, X, Y, Start. twin-stick: move and aim sticks, A, Start. one-button: one large A. quiz-4: four large A, B, X, Y buttons. racing: steering arrows, Gas (A), Brake (B), Start. paddle: a slider that stays put, A. touchpad: finger position on the look axis, A, B. lanes-4: four tall X, A, B, Y lanes. two-choice: two large A and B buttons.

sounds.description: The game's own phone sounds: a name to a file inside web/. MP3, M4A, or WAV; at most 256 KiB each and 2 MiB together. Names cannot reuse the stock sounds: click, tick, ding, success, fail, buzzer, coin, whoosh.
